phase: Phase 7 — Internet-Loss Detection, Durable Waiting & Automatic Recovery

inventory.description: Connectivity monitor with HTTPS-only probe endpoints, default TLS verification, captive portal detection, body truncation (4KB), and hysteresis state tracking.
Added listener callback framework on CircuitBreakerRegistry allowing downstream coordinators to be automatically notified when routes transition to CLOSED (recovered).

NetworkRecoveryCoordinator with automated zero-token provider recovery detection, circuit breaker listener subscription, safe recoverable blocker handling (_mark_mission_blocked), checkpoint fallback logic, and stop race prevention.

Added restore_persisted_missions logic classifying crashed RUNNING missions into WAITING_FOR_RECOVERY with interrupted_by_restart flag while safeguarding terminal/paused states; resilient workspace manager retrieval.

Full acceptance test suite expanded to 15 scenarios covering Sections A through J plus dedicated tests for provider recovery without WAN transition, recoverable blockers, startup classification, and HTTPS probe TLS/captive portal detection.
React banner component displaying connection state, waiting mission counts, and retry countdown with manual retry action.
React hook polling and subscribing to network status and coordinator auto-recovery state.
TypeScript type definitions for network status, coordinator state, and waiting mission items.
